$comment: AMH adapter for Claude Code — wiring only, no logic. All behaviour lives in the constitution and scripts/. Layers this adapter provides: the instructive pre-execution command guard (scripts/command-guard.sh, which reads the PreToolUse payload on stdin — no flag), static deny rails, and pre-allowed verification commands. It does NOT provide output redaction: Claude Code has no output-filter hook, so scripts/redact.sh stays available for manual piping and is what the ladder's secret scan and scripts/guards/staged-secrets.sh use. The SessionStart hook translates Claude Code's own CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE=true into the neutral AAB_REMOTE=1 that amh.conf names — vendor env vars are the adapter's job, never the shipped scripts'. The owner mirrors the hardest rails server-side (branch protection, secret-scanning push protection); these rules bind only agents that load them.

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ]; then export AAB_REMOTE=1; fi; exec "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/session-start.sh"'
